qs.q: A clinician is planning the diagnostic work-up for a young child presenting with unexplained global developmental delay. Thyroid function testing is universally recommended in this evaluation primarily for which reason?
o: Congenital hypothyroidism is a treatable metabolic cause
Thyroid hormones can reverse structural brain damage
Hypothyroidism always presents with microcephaly seizures
Thyroid replacement therapy completely cures fragile syndrome
qs.e: Thyroid function tests are performed on all children with delay because congenital hypothyroidism is a treatable condition. It is distinct from genetic malformations which cannot be reversed by hormone replacement.
